#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int t;
    std::cin >> t;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore the newline after t
    int totalPairs = 0;
    int longestSegment = 0;
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    for (int index = 0; index < t; index++) {
        int segmentLength = 0;
        int parenthesesCount = 0;
        for (size_t pos = 0; pos < line.size(); pos++) {
            char c = line[pos];
            if (c == '_') {
                continue;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                pos++;
                while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] != ')') {
                    if (line[pos] != '_' && line[pos] != ')') {
                        parenthesesCount++;
                        while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] != '_' && line[pos] != ')') {
                            pos++;
                        }
                    }
                    pos++;
                }
            } else {
                if (c != '_' && c != '(' && c != ')') {
                    segmentLength = 0;
                    while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] != '_' && line[pos] != '(' && line[pos] != ')') {
                        segmentLength++;
                        pos++;
                    }
                    if (segmentLength >= longestSegment) {
                        longestSegment = segmentLength;
                    }
                    pos--;
                }
            }
        }
        totalPairs += parenthesesCount;
    }
    std::cout << longestSegment << " " << totalPairs << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
